title: Mt.FUJI100 大会概要発表 (Press Release No.83, 2024 race outline)
claims: The press release dated 1 October 2023 announces that the event name changes to Mt.FUJI100 from the 2024 race, which is the 12th edition.
The 2024 FUJI100mi was scheduled from 26 April 2024 at 00:00 to 27 April 2024 at 21:00, a limit of 44 hours 30 minutes.
The 2024 FUJI100mi and KAI70k both started at midnight, and the finish venue moved to Fuji Hokuroku Park.
The 2024 FUJI100mi is listed as approximately 166.6 km with 7,039 m of accumulated gain, starting at Fujisan Kodomo no Kuni in Fuji City, Shizuoka Prefecture.
